title: A Decision-Theoretic Generalization of On-Line Learning and an Application to Boosting
summary: Yoav Freund and Robert E. Schapire published a 1995 conference paper applying a multiplicative weight-update technique to derive a new boosting algorithm that did not require prior knowledge of the weak learning algorithm's performance.
significance: A documented 1995 publication milestone in boosting research, represented as a publication event rather than an invention, priority, ancestry, or causal claim.

verification.note: Princeton's institutional research record identifies the paper, authors, 1995 publication in the EuroCOLT 1995 proceedings, pages 23-37, and states that the paper derives a new boosting algorithm that does not require prior knowledge of weak-learner performance. The later 1997 journal version is separate chronology and is not used to manufacture a more precise 1995 publication date. No development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, universal priority, or relationship edge is asserted.
